# Tencent TeamAI CLI

Структурированная запись источника. [Карточка](../../studies/tencent-teamai-cli.md) · [Первоисточник](https://github.com/Tencent/teamai-cli)

## Текущий обзор

[bk002-teamai-cli-distribution-ab-20261106](../../reviews/tencent-teamai-cli/2026-11-06-distribution-ab.md) — BOUNDED_CODE_REVIEW. Tested local-only owner port e5a0bb5901f4b1c78d7b1e28a2ba43e1cbe86db4, NOT the linked public upstream version; version_ids names source lineage only. 38 unit + 7 E2E pass; 5 seeds x8 phases/arm; TeamAI write-scope gate FAIL with 35 extra paths in disposable HOME. No production or multi-host proof.

## Итоговое исследовательское решение

**ACCEPT_BOUNDED** — ограниченный статус работы, не разрешение внедрения. Locally ported TeamAI CLI passed 40/40 offline synthetic distribution contract ops and a negative oracle mutant; minimal-home write-scope failed.

Ограничения: 35 files outside intended minimal-home paths and unequal-feature A/B; not approved for deployment.

[Доказательство](../../reviews/tencent-teamai-cli/2026-11-06-distribution-ab.md) · [Доказательство](../../data/results/tencent-teamai-cli/2026-11-06-distribution-ab.json) · [Полный реестр](../../data/results/research-portfolio/2026-11-09-closure-ledger.json)

Следующий gate: Separate target-source seam, owned A/B, oracle, latency/cost/safety and explicit human approval. Авторские результаты не считаются автоматически воспроизведёнными; project fit указан отдельно.

## Применимость к проектам

Перенесены явные документальные оценки. Это частичный охват проектов, не проверенный integration seam и не измеренная польза.

- [dsh-team-context](../../projects/dsh-team-context.md): DOCUMENTED_CANDIDATE; BOUNDED_CLI_CONTRACT_PASS / SCOPE_GATE_FAIL. Source-reviewed candidate with real isolated local-only port CLI test, but the default multi-tool write scope violated this experiment's narrow allowlist; no verified benefit on this project. Ограничения: No project production code installed or modified, source branch unavailable on GitHub, 35 unapproved paths in fake HOME; CLI run not equivalent to a user-approved multi-client install. Следующий тест: Separate owner gate: pin published reviewed source, restrict actual destination tool sets, enforce zero unexpected writes and rollback; compare feature-equal multi-host sync with Git+symlink. [Основание](../../reviews/tencent-teamai-cli/2026-11-06-distribution-ab.md); предыдущая оценка: tencent-teamai-cli-document-dsh-team-context.

## Эксперименты

- bk002-teamai-cli-distribution-ab-20261106: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. Owner local port TeamAI CLI isolated offline: build, 38/38 unit, 7/7 Git E2E, typecheck and lint pass; 5 seeds ×8 stage/arm; Git+symlink vs actual CLI 40/40 functional each; candidate scope gate FAIL with 35 distinct disallowed home paths. Local port SHA not published; source not replayable from public GitHub. Baseline not feature-parity nor human-reviewed, no real credentials/home/services; benchmark not production agent performance, RSS is cumulative and I/O counters not physical bytes. No installation.
